commitments.speaker: Manoj Jain (Chairman & Managing Director)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: For FY 2024-25, we project revenue growth of approximately 15% YoY with EBITDA margins sustained around 23% to 25%.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: Revenue from operations for FY25 stood at ₹23,200 Crore vs ₹20,180 Crore in FY24 (+14.95% YoY growth).
commitments.explanation: Actual value (14.95) matched target of 15 within precision tolerance.

commitments.speaker: Manoj Jain (Chairman & Managing Director)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Our order inflow guidance for the full financial year FY25 is targeted at ₹25,000 Crore, backed by upcoming QRSAM, naval radars, and electronic warfare contracts.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: Bharat Electronics registered order inflows of ₹25,930 Crore in FY 2024-25; order book stands at ₹76,200 Crore.
commitments.explanation: Actual value (25930) met or exceeded guided minimum target of 25000.

commitments.speaker: Ashish Mangal (Managing Director)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Looking ahead into FY25 and FY26, with our strong order book and expanding presence in railway and high-voltage transmission, we guide for annual revenue growth exceeding 15% with disciplined working capital.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: Revenue from operations increased by 16.73% YoY to ₹868.4 Crore in FY25.
commitments.explanation: Actual value (16.73) met or exceeded guided minimum target of 15.

commitments.speaker: Ashish Mangal (Managing Director)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: The company has undertaken capex of ₹35 Crore to set up a dedicated manufacturing line for solar cables and MV power cables at the Reengus plant, targeted for commercial commissioning by Q3 FY25.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: Commercial production of solar and MV cables successfully commenced on December 18, 2024 at Reengus plant.
commitments.explanation: Milestone event was completed and verified by exchange disclosure within deadline.

commitments.speaker: Murari Lal Poddar (Chief Financial Officer)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Given the current copper and aluminium price stabilization and pass-through contracts, we maintain guidance of operating EBITDA margin in the range of 10.5% to 11.5% for H2 FY25.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: H2 FY25 EBITDA was ₹49.1 Crore on operating revenue of ₹453.8 Crore (10.82% operating margin).
commitments.explanation: Actual value (10.82) achieved within the guided corridor of 10.5 to 11.5.

commitments.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan (Managing Director & CEO)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Post-merger, our credit-to-deposit ratio elevated to 110%. Our conscious strategy over FY25 is to grow deposits faster than advances and bring down the CD ratio towards the pre-merger corridor below 100% and ultimately 85-90%.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: Deposits grew 15.1% while advances grew 6.5%, reducing Credit-Deposit ratio from 110.5% to 98.2% as of March 31, 2025.
commitments.explanation: Actual value (98.2) successfully stayed at or below the guided ceiling of 100.

commitments.speaker: Kaizad Bharucha (Deputy Managing Director)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: We plan to open 1,000 to 1,200 new branch locations in FY25 to deepen our semi-urban and rural deposit franchise.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: HDFC Bank added 912 new branch locations in FY25, taking the total network to 9,092 branches.
commitments.explanation: Actual value (912) achieved 91.2% of target floor (1000), qualifying as PARTIALLY_MET under generic 90% threshold.

commitments.speaker: Isha Ambani (Executive Director, Reliance Retail)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Reliance Retail targets adding over 2,500 new stores and scaling gross square footage above 70 million sq. ft. in FY24.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: Reliance Retail added 2,707 new stores during FY24, bringing total store footprint to 79.1 million sq. ft.
commitments.explanation: Actual value (2707) met or exceeded guided minimum target of 2500.

commitments.speaker: Mukesh D. Ambani (Chairman & Managing Director)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Jio’s True 5G rollout will be complete across the length and breadth of India by December 2023, making it the fastest 5G rollout of this scale globally.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: Pan-India True 5G network rollout completed in December 2023 with 90M+ subscribers on standalone architecture.
commitments.explanation: Milestone event was completed and verified by exchange disclosure within deadline.

commitments.speaker: Samir Seksaria (Chief Financial Officer)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Our aspirational and guided operating margin band remains 26% to 28%. While headwinds from wage hikes exist in H1, our medium-term target for FY25 is to exit the year within or near the 26-28% corridor.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: Full year FY25 consolidated operating margin was 24.4% (Q4 exit at 24.6%), falling short of 26-28% guided band.
commitments.explanation: Actual value (24.4) missed the guided corridor of 26 to 28.

commitments.speaker: Milind Lakkad (Chief Human Resources Officer)
commitments.sourceExcerpt: We plan to onboard approximately 40,000 fresh engineering graduates from campuses in India across FY2024-25 as part of our talent pyramid pipeline.
commitments.evidenceExcerpt: TCS onboarded 42,000 fresh campus engineering graduates across FY2024-25.
commitments.explanation: Actual value (42000) met or exceeded guided minimum target of 40000.
